items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1969-06-17
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'Dick' in the context of a location ('Right there where Dick was talking about...'), but does not describe a personal, professional, or social relationship with Dick Allen.

ctx.x: Yeah. T. Rouch, or no, no, I mean not him. Bikes. And that boy would do Rodney, that boy plays. He was playing. Then I had with the chorus playing, you know, he play with Fat Domino now. He used to play guitar. He played bass with Fat Domino. Little short fella. Oh I know, Jimmy Davis. Yeah, Jim. From up to Carrollton. Yeah, little Jim. Little Jim played with us a long time. And then on his rope rope. He told me that you told me. Yeah, on his rope rope, playing with me there. You know what I mean? But I'll tell…
What about you? You got a middle name?
Well my name is Dick Allen and I won't tell you my real name. I've heard of him.
Did you ever know kid Louis Armstrong Thomas?
